articles.title: Sony PS5 Relapse Jailbreak Exploit Uses JSC Memory Corruption and Kernel UAF
articles.summary:
A newly released PlayStation 5 jailbreak chain, called Relapse, targets PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles running firmware versions 7.00 through 13.60. This jailbreak combines a browser-based JavaScriptCore memory corruption technique with a kernel use-after-free race condition. articles.summary:

articles.summary:

articles.title: TIKTOUK WordPress Toolkit Could Enable AWS, SMTP and API Credential Theft Attacks
articles.summary:

articles.title: Authentication Bypass Successfully Impersonated 95 Users Without Passwords or MFA
articles.summary:

The issue stemmed from two flaws in the application’s custom session-cookie implementation: a predictable hard-coded signing secret and the use of public database identifiers as authenticated session payloads.
